messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT OPENED / high-sev / GPU memory surge in us-west-2 serving pool during request warm-up. Containers restarting in hotpool-2. Paging oncall.

alicia_oncall: I'm on it, seeing ~30 restarts in last 5m for hotpool-2. Node flaps + OOMs. Kube events show CrashLoopBackOff.

sam_sre: grabbing logs + metrics now. grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/serve?panel=mem_uswest2 -> memory spiked to 96-99% before restarts.

alicia_oncall: logs: `cuda runtime error: out of memory` in prefill allocator stage. Looks like large warm-up requests with long context triggered it.

maria_runtime: this matches a regression in the prefill buffer accounting we rolled last week. It underestimates KV cache retention for long sequences.

sam_sre: immediate mitigation: evict tolerant pods and drain one affected node to stop thrashing. running: `kubectl drain ip-10-0-45-12.us-west-2.compute.internal --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`

alicia_oncall: doing rolling cordon/drain across hotpool-2 to prevent noisy neighbor restarts. will scale down new scheduling to hotpool-1.

maria_runtime: two quick config mitigations we can flip now: 1) reduce per-request max_prefill_tokens to 2048 for affected route, 2) enable fallback routing to quantized-8bit variant. I can toggle routing rule.

kevin_prod: do the fallback now, customers are seeing 5xxs. prefer a quick fallback -> capture degraded perf but keep availability.

maria_runtime: applying fallback rule: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.local/admin/routes/fallback -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","variant":"quant-8b","predicate":"us-west-2"}'` -> done, propagated to edge.

deploy-bot: hotpatch rollout started for runtime change commit c8f3b2a -> enabling prefill guard rails.

jess_cs: CS note: two customers (acct: acme-inc, acct: storyflow) reported elevated 500s starting 15:12 UTC. Created ticket #CS-2026 and updated with initial mitigation.

alicia_oncall: continuing to monitor. reduced incoming traffic to hotpool-2 from 100% -> 30% by routing. restarts dropped to 0 in last 3m on drained nodes.

sam_sre: still seeing a handful of containers with ephemeral OOMs on allocation path; those are draining. Overall cluster mem headroom improved after fallback.

maria_runtime: pushing a small runtime fix to prefill allocator (guard against KV double-count) -> merged to canary. Patch id: pr/1429. Rolling canary to 2 nodes.

deploy-bot: canary deployment succeeded on two nodes. No OOMs observed for canary.

alicia_oncall: scaling up hotpool capacity by +2 nodes to buy time while we validate patch. `kubectl scale rs/hotpool-2-2026 --replicas=12`

kevin_prod: notify affected customers with ETA ~30m, mention fallback to quantized variant and that we are restoring full capacity. jess_cs pls send update.

jess_cs: sending update now. message: "We've routed your traffic to a lower-memory model variant to restore availability. We're rolling a runtime patch; expecting normal service in ~30-45 minutes. Apologies for the disruption."

sam_sre: monitoring graphs: memory utilization down to 65% cluster-wide after scale + fallback. error rate back to baseline for most tenants.

maria_runtime: after canary validation, promoting patch to hotpool-2. Rolling restart window scheduled, will do staggered restarts to avoid mass prefill at once.

alicia_oncall: performing staggered rollout: restart 2 pods every 60s.

alicia_oncall: restarted all pods with patched runtime. Observed no additional OOMs on long sequence smoke tests (2 tests @ 12k tokens).

deploy-bot: runtime patch rollout complete.

sam_sre: confirming cluster stable. CPU/mem/gpu metrics nominal. No flapping nodes.

kevin_prod: prepare incident summary for postmortem: root cause = prefill buffer accounting regression leading to underestimation of KV cache for long contexts; sequence of long warm-up requests caused memory fragmentation and OOMs -> container restarts. Mitigations: immediate routing fallback to quantized variant, node drain, scale up hotpool, runtime guard rails patch.

jess_cs: customers notified and ticket updates posted. one customer requested SLA credit, escalated to acct team.

alicia_oncall: closing incident. followup: write postmortem PR assigning owners: runtime fix + longer-term: add prefill memory e2e for long-context, and automated fallback thresholds based on per-request mem estimation.

incident-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED / duration ~13m / severity: high -> mitigated. Summary posted to #postmortems. :white_check_mark:
